content_sections.heading: About GBPNIHE
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment is located at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora, Uttarakhand. This position falls under its NMHS funded project "Inventorization of Taxonomic Diversity, Habitat Mapping, Conservation and Livelihood Linkages of the Aroid Flora in the Eastern Himalaya and Northeast India".

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE JRF and JPF Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Conduct field-based vegetation assessment and database management. Carry out spatial analysis and report writing. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE JRF and JPF Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 28 years. Essential qualification: First Class Master degree in Botany/Forestry/Remote Sensing & GIS/Ecology/Environment Science/Life Science or relevant discipline from a recognized university. Desirable qualifications: Experience in vegetation survey/plant identification/database management with reference to the north-eastern region of India. Experience in forest inventories/Remote Sensing and GIS with reference to Himalaya. Preference will be given to candidates having working experience in the Himalaya. Minimum requirements of qualifications and/or experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first, and shortlisted candidates are informed separately about the mode, date and time of the interview. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to an interview or test. If a large number of applications is received, the Institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number called for interview or test, in line with the number of vacancies. It may also shortlist and select candidates in any suitable position, depending on the qualification and experience required for the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary in nature. The Institute reserves the right to disengage the manpower at any time without assigning any reasons. The position is at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora, but the selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, and to fill or not fill any or all of the posts. In any dispute or ambiguity over eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, or the conduct of the examination or interview, the Institute's decision is final. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPNIHE JRF and JPF Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the GBPNIHE online recruitment portal . Submit the application for post code HQ 26-27-2101 through the portal, which is the only way to apply. Mention all your qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed, supported with documents. Complete the submission on or before 11:59 PM on the last date. Documents for a physical interview: Original documents of educational qualifications and experience. One set of photocopies of these documents.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply without NET?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate without NET is considered for the Junior Project Fellow designation at Rs 24,000/- a month plus HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q2. Which subjects are accepted for this position?
faq.answer: The accepted fields are Botany, Forestry, Remote Sensing & GIS, Ecology, Environment Science, Life Science or a relevant discipline, with a First Class Master degree from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No experience is listed as essential. Experience in vegetation survey, plant identification, database management, forest inventories or Remote Sensing and GIS is desirable, and working experience in the Himalaya earns preference.

faq.question: Q4. Will my experience count without a certificate?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that experience will not be considered without an experience certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What work will the selected candidate do?
faq.answer: The work covers field-based vegetation assessment, database management, spatial analysis and report writing for the aroid flora project in the Eastern Himalaya and Northeast India.

faq.question: Q6. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How soon must the selected candidate join?
faq.answer: The selected candidate is expected to join immediately.
